name: lean-agents
description: Reduced-toolset sub-agent profiles (read-only, lean-executor, standard-executor, main, full-executor) that lower System-tools token overhead vs. spawning the default agent. Pair with project-tasks, which dispatches to these agents by name.

interface.shortDescription: Reduced-toolset sub-agent profiles for Claude Code.
interface.longDescription: Five Claude Code sub-agent profiles, from read-only to full-executor, that carry only the tools a sub-task needs. Codex plugins cannot bundle custom agents, so this plugin installs no Codex components yet.
